messages:
Maria (CS): FYI — Polaris Health dedicated bring-up scheduled Wed 09:00 PT. We need final quota numbers, autoscale policy, and a short load test plan by EOD Tue. Renewal touchpoint is 11/10 so this is high priority.
Jake S. (Eng): +1. Current estimate: steady-state 600 rps for their main /generate route, peaks ~1.2k for 60s bursts. I'd recommend starting with 6x A100s reserved and allow 2x burst nodes for autoscale.
Sophie Ops: Can someone own the runbook steps for the smoke -> load -> cutover sequence? I'll coordinate monitoring and dashboard access.
Anil P. (Acct): I'll join the call with Polaris to align expectations after the smoke tests. We should capture any perf hits tied to specific prompt patterns — that's a renewal risk area.
Ryan (DevEx): I have a small load script that mimics their prompt mix. I'll share it in the thread. Use k6 with the scenario that mixes 75% short prompts, 25% long context. Command:
```
k6 run --vus 100 --duration 5m load/polaris-mix.js
```
This scales locally against the staging endpoint.
Jake S. (Eng): For autoscale config propose: min_replicas: 4, target_rps_per_replica: 150, cooldown: 90s, burst_capacity: +2. That should avoid overscaling on short spikes.
Kai (SRE): Make sure KV prefix cache warmup is part of the smoke. If we start without KV cache we'll see 30-40% higher token CPU. Plan: prewarm with 20 representative requests per model shard.
Maria (CS): Sophie, can you add prewarm to the runbook? Also add a quick checklist to collect sample prompts and token distribution for the eval.
Sophie Ops: Will do. Draft runbook snippet:
```
1) Confirm reserved pool is provisioned (6 A100)
2) Apply autoscale policy (min 4, burst +2)
3) Prewarm KV with collection script (20 reqs/shard)
4) Run smoke test (k6 2m @ 50rps)
5) Run load test (k6 defined mix, ramp 50->600 rps over 10m, hold 10m)
6) Validate SLOs and tail latency, collect traces
7) Gradual cutover and handoff to CS call
```
Anil P. (Acct): Suggest we add an explicit step to collect user-facing error samples and map them to retries/backoff. That will help with renewal conversation.
Ryan (DevEx): Uploading the load script to the shared folder now: https://files.redwood/polaris/load/polaris-mix.js (permissions: Polaris-view for temp access).
DeployBot: Deployment started: reserved-pool/polaris-2026-03-25 at 2026-03-25T08:02:20Z
DeployBot: Deployment succeeded: reserved-pool/polaris-2026-03-25 at 2026-03-25T08:08:03Z :white_check_mark:
Kai (SRE): After deployment, I'll run KV prewarm and post a short pastebin of latency percentiles. Plan to measure p50/p95/p99 for token latency and end-to-end.
Maria (CS): Team — can we lock the final numbers here? Reserved: 6 A100, autoscale min 4, burst +2, load window Wed 09:00-11:00 PT. Sophie to run tests; Kai to verify metrics; Ryan provides script; Jake on-call for infra tweaks.
Jake S. (Eng): Locked for now. I'll keep an eye on shard placement and remote disk I/O during the test.
Sophie Ops: I'll run the smoke test 08:30 PT and the full load at 09:05 PT. Posting results in this thread.
Anil P. (Acct): I'll join the post-test call at 10:30 PT to go over findings with Polaris.
Ryan (DevEx): Quick note — remember to rotate the API key after tests. I'll generate a temporary key with 2h TTL.
Sophie Ops: Smoke results: p50 tokens 12ms, p95 tokens 48ms, no 5xxs. Moving to full load in 10m.
Sophie Ops: Load test end: sustained 650 rps hold 10m. p99 token latency 210ms, error rate 0.07% (mostly 429 throttles during a short burst). Collected traces and logs at https://playbacks.redwood/polaris/20260325.
Kai (SRE): Observations: KV warmup helped — drop from ~320ms p95 to 48ms p95. Throttles aligned with a single frontend instance hitting a rate limiter; recommend slight increase in route quota and smoothing the burst policy.
Maria (CS): Great data — Anil, we can present this as reduced technical risk and propose a one-time quota bump + smoothing policy to avoid spikes. That should de-risk renewal.
Anil P. (Acct): Agreed. I'll propose the quota bump in the renewal packet and schedule a follow-up demo of the dashboards.
Jake S. (Eng): I'll file a short infra follow-up to auto-smooth rate limiter behavior and add a canary to the autoscale policy.
Maria (CS): Thanks everyone — this is in good shape. Sophie, drop the final runbook link and the summary of results here when you have a minute. :thumbsup:
Sophie Ops: Final runbook + results uploaded: https://docs.redwood/polaris/onboarding-runbook-20260325.pdf — closing thread after the follow-up call.
